questions: If you could build a monument to the concept of 'hope,' what would it look like and how would it function?
If you could create a new fundamental law of physics, what would it be and how would it alter reality? (Don’t worry about making it scientifically plausible – just explore the possibilities.)
What is the most beautiful thing you’ve ever lost, and why was it so profoundly moving? (This can be a tangible object, an idea, or a relationship.)
